discrepancy_explanation: In RCA-2A.24 reports, references to '28 Test Cases', '16 Browser Sub-verifications', and '34 Verifications Passed' caused ambiguity between verification checks and pytest test functions. This amendment provides authoritative accounting based on actual execution logs.

suite_runner_checks.scope: Preflight git/DB, HTTP feature gates, security headers, budget/idempotency, restart recovery, evidence integrity, provider zero

browser_e2e_checks.scope: Chromium UI layout, cycle 1 execution, candidate inspection, explicit accept, reload 1, cycle 2 execution, malware candidate inspection, explicit reject, reload 2, disclosure notice

accounting_breakdown.historical_28_cases_origin: Informal shorthand counting 12 HTTP/security checks (T04-T15) plus 16 browser checks (RC-B01-RC-B16), omitting baseline checks (T01-T03) and post-flight checks (T16-T18). The actual acceptance suite executed exactly 34 verification assertions (18 runner + 16 browser).

python_agent_review_unit_tests.scope: T01-T45 covering candidate resolution, hash verification, review submission, idempotency, provenance, epistemic preservation, and T35-T45 security boundaries
